ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) and 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black central region at the fluke base. Intricate black linear mottling and branching patterns distributed across the high-intensity white lobes. Higher density of black clusters present on the inner right lobe and along the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible narrow V-shaped central depression. Symmetrical indentation with a steep interior angle estimated at 30 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Irregular pixel-depth variations ranging from 5-15 pixels creating a jagged contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges tapering to sharp, slightly irregular tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters visible near the distal tips of both lobes, most prominent on the far left extremity.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear black pixel disruptions (rake marks) intersecting across the white ventral surface of both lobes at various vertical and diagonal angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across both lobes. The trailing edge tips, particularly on the left, show irregular terminal geometry suggesting minor tissue loss or previous trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Dendritic black pigmentation patterns radiating from the central peduncle attachment point into the white lobe surfaces.
